name: TIC 220392347

text.card: A red giant 1,049 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded by TESS, give 0.96 solar masses and 10.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,810 K at its surface.
